title: heracleum sphondylium subsp. montanum
intro: Heracleum sphondylium subsp. montanum, commonly known as mountain cow parsley, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Heracleum sphondylium subsp. montanum include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and flavonoids, which may help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu.
